decisions.statement: A child of this supervisor already there is adopted rather than joined by a second.
An inherited pid confirmed dead is not respawned.
A spawn is refused where the host is under memory pressure.
A child spawned afresh runs no task the child before it started.
The open tasks of such a child are taken as closed before the spawn.
An adopted child is the same client.
The open tasks of an adopted child are left alone.
A child spawned afresh runs no subagent the child before it started.
The subagent pages under such a child's seat are taken away before the spawn.
The subagent pages of an adopted child are left alone.
That take-down is asked for and left to finish rather than waited on.
What this reaches for to adopt, to spawn and to take is handed in.

definition: a live Claude child adopted where one is there and spawned where none is
